notes: 3 menu photos. 1.jpg and 2.jpg are the same hand-painted 'Super-Tortas Gigantes' board photographed July 2024 and Sep 2021; merged as one menu, using the newer (2024) prices where legible and the 2021 photo only to confirm item names where a 2024 price sticker was blank/illegible (those kept without a price). 3.jpg is a digital menu board (paleteria/neveria items plus a tacos/hamburguesas/hot dogs panel) whose taco/burger/tostada prices matched the older 2021 board exactly, so it reads as stale for those overlapping items and was skipped in favor of the 2024 board; its paleteria/neveria items and the alambre taco are unique and were kept.
